notes: Base APK + content updates: the APK is now just the shell (layout, WebView, updater code). Trip content — itinerary, guides, app code, audio, documents — is pulled from GitHub and cached on the phone, and Settings > Content updates downloads only the files that changed (verified by SHA-256), falling back to the bundled copy if anything fails. This version itself is still a full APK install once; every content change after it is small. Settings gains a Content updates section with an auto-check toggle.
